line.en: the national museum is free from 17:00 to 20:00 on thursdays until 17 december. walk over from the city centre and look round at your own pace.
line.de: das nationalmuseum ist donnerstags bis 17. dezember von 17 bis 20 uhr kostenlos. zu fuß aus der innenstadt hinübergehen und in ruhe schauen.
line.tr: nationalmuseum perşembeleri 17 aralık'a kadar 17:00 ile 20:00 arası ücretsiz. şehir merkezinden yürüyerek gidip kendi hızında gezin.

sparks.why: Nationalmuseum's thursday evenings are free 17:00 to 20:00 from 3 Sep to 17 Dec 2026 per the museum and Visit Stockholm; the programme varies, so no particular event is promised.
